## Stella Sora Cheats — iOS Mod Menu

**Target Bundle ID:** `com.YoStarEN.StellaSora`  
**Architecture:** `arm64` (Rootless) & `arm64e` (RootHide)

---

### ⚔️ Tab 1 — Combat (`HP, Defense, Attack & Damage`)
- **Activate Pro God Preset (1-Tap)** — Enables God Mode & 1-Hit Kill in one tap
- **God Mode (Invincible)** — Maxes HP/DEF (`99,999,999`) & `100%` all-type damage reduction (`GENDMGRCD`)
- **HP Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Scales character Max HP & floor `initHp`
- **Defense Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiplies character DEF stat
- **1-Hit Kill Enemies** — Maxes ATK, `FINALDMG`, `CritRate` & `100%` `DefIgnore`
- **Damage Multiplier (`1x – 100x`)** — Adds Final DMG% multiplier (`FINALDMG`)
- **Attack Stat Multiplier (`1x – 50x`)** — Multiplies character base ATK stat

### ⚡ Tab 2 — Actions (`Battle Actions`)
- **Instant Full Heal Party** — Restores active party HP to `100%` max via `AdventureModuleHelper.ResetActorAttributes`

### 🛠️ Tab 3 — Lua Tools (`Auto-Scanner & Diagnostics`)
- **Relocation-Independent ARM64 XLua Scanner** — Automatically locates `luaL_loadbufferx`, `lua_pcallk`, `lua_gettop`, `lua_settop` & `luaL_tolstring` across game updates
- **Scan / Reload / Dump Tools** — Live Lua battle module scanner & hot-reload support

---

### 🛡️ Protection & Cloud Auto-Update
- **Cloud + On-Device Auto-Offset Engine** — Automatically resolves updated offsets across game updates without waiting for a new `.deb`
- **1-User License System** — Hardware UDID / Keychain device token binding via Hunter's license server
- **Glass UI Floating Mod Menu** — Draggable floating button, multi-tab layout, live sliders & persistent settings

**v2.0.0**
- Initial release for Stella Sora (`com.YoStarEN.StellaSora` v2.0.0)
- Includes invariant ARM64 XLua auto-scanner + 1-User Device Token Lock
